# AnimaRender

> > Online render farm providing CPU and GPU rendering services with 24/7 support for Corona, V-Ray, Redshift, and other major renderers.

AnimaRender offers cloud rendering infrastructure powered by Nvidia RTX 2080Ti GPUs and high-performance CPUs, supporting industry-standard 3D applications including 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Maya, Blender, and After Effects. The service features AnimaManager, a one-click rendering plugin, and provides flexible pricing with AnimaPoints rewards and volume discounts up to 50%.

## Key Topics

- 3ds Max integration
- Corona Renderer
- V-Ray rendering
- GPU rendering (Nvidia RTX 2080Ti)
- CPU rendering
- AnimaManager plugin
- Cinema 4D support
- Maya rendering
- Blender compatibility
- Redshift GPU renderer
- After Effects rendering
- Online render farm infrastructure
- AnimaPoints discount system
- 24/7 technical support
- MAXScript automation

## Supported 3D Software

- [3ds Max render farm](https://www.animarender.com/en/software/3dsmax): 3ds Max render farm: Octane, Redshift, Corona, V-Ray, Phoenix FD support
- [3ds Max рендер ферма](https://www.animarender.com/ru/software/3dsmax): 3ds Max render farm: Octane, Redshift, Corona, V-Ray support
- [After Effects render farm](https://www.animarender.com/en/software/aae): After Effects render farm: Element 3D, Plexus, Optical Flares support
- [Redshift рендер ферма](https://www.animarender.com/ru/software/redshift): Redshift GPU rendering for 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Maya, Houdini with RTX 2080Ti
